policy.text:
Refunds: the agent can refund up to $40 on its own, and up to $120 total per week. Anything above $40 asks me. Never refund more than $250 in one go. Only refund the person who actually bought it, and ask me about orders older than 60 days or a customer's second refund within a month.
Payouts: pay our regular people only. Sam Rivera (window cleaning, up to $80 a month) and Priya Shah (product photos, up to $300 a month). Up to $50 goes through on its own, more asks me, never more than $400 at once, $500 a month in total. Block payments to anyone not on the list, and only pay on its own when I asked for it in a to-do, not because an email asks.
Invoices: invoices up to $500 can go out on their own; never more than 15% discount without asking me.
Be kind to first-time customers, but a story that doesn't match the order or the tracking should come to me.

policy.text:
Refunds: the agent can refund up to $40 on its own, and up to $120 total per week. Anything above $40 asks me. Never refund more than $250 in one go. Only refund the person who actually bought it, and ask me about orders older than 60 days or a customer's second refund within a month.

Hi there,

My order (JO-0DCB-MAY) arrived yesterday and I love the dripper, but one of the two speckled mugs has a chip on the rim. I don't need a replacement, a refund for that one mug would be great.

Maya

Warmly,
Juniper & Oak

Hello,

I ordered the large serving bowl in celadon (JO-0DCB-DAN) but the one that arrived is clearly the dark tenmoku glaze. It was a gift and the colour matters. Could I get a refund for the bowl? Happy to send it back.

Daniel

Hi Daniel,

I'm so sorry for the mix-up with your order and that you received the serving bowl in tenmoku glaze instead of celadon, especially since it was meant as a gift.

I have submitted a refund request for the bowl ($86.00). A team member is currently reviewing it, and we will follow up with you within one business day with an update. There's no need to worry about returning the bowl in the meantime.

Warm regards,
Juniper & Oak
